items.title: Shared Tauri invoke wrappers (native.ts)
items.rationale: native.workspaceAuthorize is used outside AI (spaces boot, workspace switcher, App, git status). Move the non-AI wrappers to a neutral platform layer before deleting the AI module (F2:3, 9.9:4); the ai_* / shell_bg_* wrappers go with the AI removal.
items.risks: workspace_authorize gates fs access for restored Spaces; a wrong move breaks session restore.

items.title: Sensitive-path read policy (security.ts + pathPolicy.json)
items.rationale: Not AI-only: markdown preview uses checkReadable and the Rust fs read policy include_str!s pathPolicy.json. Move to a neutral module and add lut's own data/cache dirs to the protected list (14.1:4, F0:10). Terax dir entries can stay (still sensitive).
items.risks: Moving pathPolicy.json breaks the Rust include_str! path at compile time; both must move in one PR.

items.title: Code-block renderer shared by chat and markdown preview
items.rationale: Markdown preview depends on MarkdownCode; chat-code imports useChatStore (chat-code.tsx:5). Visuals are Terax design (replace after the user's design); the lezer highlighter logic can move to the markdown module. Must be decoupled from chatStore before AI deletion (F2:4).
items.risks: Markdown preview loses code highlighting if deleted with the chat.

items.title: Chat UI primitives (conversation, message, reasoning, tool, snippet, context)
items.rationale: Only used by the BYOK chat. ADR-004 rejects built-in BYOK AI; 5.8 and F2:4 remove the chat.

items.title: AI chat, mini window, composer, status-bar controls, approvals, pickers
items.rationale: BYOK chat UI and its providers/bridges (AiComposerProvider, AiMiniWindow, AgentRunBridge, LocalAgentNotificationsBridge, SelectionAskAi, useAiBootstrap) are listed for removal in 9.9:1/9.9:5, F2:4; ADR-004.
items.risks: LocalAgentNotificationsBridge reuses the CLI-agent notification pipeline; removing it must not break CLI agent notifications (agents area).

items.title: Provider/model catalog, API-key keyring client, model prefs
items.rationale: Provider keys and models are BYOK (ADR-004, AGT-003, 16:16). KEYRING_SERVICE = "terax-ai" (config.ts:1) is shared with an installed Terax in the OS keychain: Phase 0 must change it (F0:10) before removal lands.
items.risks: settings store persists AI keys/prefs; removing types from settings/store.ts needs a tolerant migration of old persisted values.

items.title: Agent loop, transport, proxy fetch, prompts, compaction, STT, sessions, snippets, todos
items.rationale: Vercel AI SDK agent runtime for BYOK providers (ADR-004, F2:4). agent.ts:158 sends HTTP-Referer https://terax.ai (F0:5 outbound audit).
items.risks: useAppCloseGuard flushes AI sessions on close; remove that call in the same PR as the call-site cut.

items.title: Zustand stores: chat, chat runtime, agents, plan, snippets, todos
items.rationale: AI-only state (9.9:1 useChatStore). Several other areas read useChatStore (statusbar, terminal BlockOverlay, source-control, agents review); cut those first (F2:4, F2:5).
items.risks: agents/lib/review.ts routes CLI review results into the AI chat; agents area must decide the replacement before deletion.

items.title: AI tool definitions (fs, edit, search, shell, terminal, todo, subagent) and subagent registry
items.rationale: Tools exposed to the BYOK model (9.9:1 'herramientas AI'); ADR-004.
items.risks: After removal the Rust fs/ai.rs and shell background/session commands may be dead code; their areas must check.

items.title: Rust AI conversation files (ai_sessions.rs)
items.rationale: Persists BYOK chat sessions under app_data_dir (ai_sessions.rs:519); no lut requirement (ADR-004). Store names are scoped by the bundle id, so isolation comes with the identity change.
items.risks: None after the frontend is gone.

items.title: Rust AI HTTP streaming proxy with SSRF guard (net.rs, net/)
items.rationale: Only consumers are AI proxyFetch and Settings lm_ping (ModelsSection.tsx:904,1121); the updater does not use it. F0:5 lists it for the outbound audit; removed with BYOK (F2:4, F2:7).
items.risks: clients.rs:119 installs the rustls ring provider; its comment says the updater installs the same one. Confirm the updater still works without it when lut's updater is set up (F7).

items.title: Rust secrets store (OS keychain / Linux file)
items.rationale: Only used for AI provider keys (keyring.ts). lut requires no API keys (AGT-003, 16:16, 13.2:17). Windows/macOS keychain entries are not scoped by bundle id, so the service name "terax-ai" shares keys with an installed Terax until removed (F0:10).
items.risks: If a future feature needs secrets (none in the proposal), it would be re-added; PRJ-015/F4:8 only require not exporting secrets.

notes: Inbound couplings span app-shell (App.tsx, WorkspaceInputBar, useAppCloseGuard, useWorkspaceSwitcher), spaces, explorer, markdown, settings (store + Models/Agents sections + ProviderIcon/KeyCard), editor (autocomplete), source-control (AI commit message), statusbar, terminal (BlockOverlay), agents (review.ts), shortcuts (ai.toggle/toggleMini/askSelection), command-palette (toggleAi/askAiSelection), tabs (ai-diff tab kind, useTabs.ts:86,925-960), styles/compositingBudget.test.ts, app dist/eager budget tests, vite.config.ts manualChunks for @ai-sdk/*. Rust fs/ai.rs commands and shell session/bg commands are consumed only by AI tools via native.ts. Phase 0: KEYRING_SERVICE "terax-ai" (config.ts:1) collides with an installed Terax in the OS keychain.
